vertebrae.config
================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.config

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Public configuration objects for vertebrae.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.config.OverlapScoringConfig
   vertebrae.config.StabilityConfig
   vertebrae.config.ProbeConfig
   vertebrae.config.CacheConfig
   vertebrae.config.EmbeddingConfig
   vertebrae.config.MemoryConfig


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: OverlapScoringConfig

   Configuration for MiniBatchKMeans-backed OverlapIndex scoring.

   .. attribute:: k

      Global k, class-to-k mapping, or `"auto"` for per-class resolution.

   .. attribute:: min_k

      Lower target used by automatic k resolution.

   .. attribute:: max_k

      Maximum k allowed for any class.

   .. attribute:: min_samples_per_cluster

      Minimum class samples expected per prototype.

   .. attribute:: kmeans_kwargs

      Extra keyword arguments passed to MiniBatchKMeans.

   .. attribute:: offline_chunk_size

      Chunk size forwarded to `OverlapIndex.fit_offline`.

   .. attribute:: normalize_embeddings

      Whether to L2-normalize embeddings before scoring.

   .. attribute:: max_dense_bytes

      Maximum sparse-to-dense allocation allowed for scoring.


.. py:class:: StabilityConfig

   Configuration for prototype or subsample stability analysis.

   .. attribute:: enabled

      Whether stability analysis should run.

   .. attribute:: mode

      Stability mode: `"prototype"`, `"subsample"`, or `"none"`.

   .. attribute:: repeats

      Number of repeated scoring runs.

   .. attribute:: interval_level

      Percentile interval level reported in summaries.

   .. attribute:: subsample_fraction

      Fraction sampled for subsample stability.

   .. attribute:: stratified

      Whether subsampling should preserve class membership.

   .. attribute:: random_state

      Seed used to generate repeat seeds and subsamples.


.. py:class:: ProbeConfig

   Configuration for lightweight probe classifiers.

   .. attribute:: enabled

      Whether probe evaluation should run.

   .. attribute:: test_size

      Fraction of samples held out for probe testing.

   .. attribute:: random_state

      Seed used for train/test splitting.

   .. attribute:: methods

      Probe classifiers to evaluate.


.. py:class:: CacheConfig

   Artifact cache settings.

   .. attribute:: enabled

      Whether embedding artifacts should be cached.

   .. attribute:: cache_dir

      Local cache directory or artifact-store URI.

   .. attribute:: force_recompute

      Whether to ignore cache hits and recompute embeddings.

   .. attribute:: storage_options

      Provider-specific store options such as S3 endpoint URLs.

   .. attribute:: metadata

      Additional user metadata to preserve with cache settings.


.. py:class:: EmbeddingConfig

   Configuration for embedding generation and materialization.

   .. attribute:: batch_size

      Number of samples to pass to streaming-safe extractors.

   .. attribute:: streaming_enabled

      Whether streaming-safe extractors should be embedded
      batch-by-batch instead of in one full transform call.

   .. attribute:: shard

      Optional deterministic shard assignment. Local benchmarking requires
      a complete shard, but this field is available for future distributed
      embedding jobs.


.. py:class:: MemoryConfig

   Memory budget and admission-control settings.

   .. attribute:: max_memory_bytes

      Explicit process memory budget. When `None`, the budget
      is derived from current available memory using `psutil`.

   .. attribute:: reserve_system_bytes

      Memory to leave available for the OS and other
      processes. When `None`, a conservative reserve is selected.

   .. attribute:: max_fraction

      Maximum fraction of currently available memory to use.

   .. attribute:: allow_disk_spill

      Whether large embedding artifacts may be streamed to disk.

   .. attribute:: fail_fast

      Whether to raise before expensive work when estimates exceed
      the configured budget.

   .. attribute:: probe_batch_size

      Number of samples used to infer unknown embedding shape.

   .. attribute:: model_memory_bytes

      Optional model memory hint included in admission checks.

   .. attribute:: raw_batch_memory_bytes

      Optional raw batch memory hint included in checks.

   .. attribute:: subsample_rate

      Fraction of samples to keep before embedding and scoring.
      A value of `1.0` disables user-requested subsampling.

   .. attribute:: subsample_random_state

      Seed used for deterministic stratified subsampling.

   .. attribute:: min_subsample_samples_per_class

      Minimum retained samples per class when
      class sizes allow it.

   .. attribute:: auto_subsample_on_memory_exceeded

      Whether to warn and select the largest
      fitting stratified subsample instead of raising when a full embedding
      artifact would exceed memory.
